description:
Edit repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts to satisfy the following request. The relevant code is in the region "recommendReachingPath". If that file is the wrong target, say so rather than editing it.

In goal-host-vessel src/index.ts, recommendReachingPath's eligible.sort (around line 5758) ranks shape_signature-matched pathway-reuse candidates by successful_executions descending only, with no signal for success_rate or whether a candidate carries a deterministic verifier. Change the sort so it ranks by success_rate descending first (falling back to successful_executions, then total_executions, as before), so a pathway with fewer but more reliable executions is not permanently outranked by a pathway with one more raw success. Keep exact-goal-hash match still ranked above shape_signature match as it is today.
